title: Equal-circle packing inside a square
summary: Certified lower bounds for equal circles in a unit square at 12 counts from 100 to 800, each witness checked with exact integer arithmetic, with record comparisons kept separate from novelty.

credit.policy: Retain original construction credit; identify code, certificates, audit and verification contributions separately. Disclose AI assistance. No automatic coauthorship. See CONTRIBUTORS.md.

requirements.note: Python 3.10+ for verification; pinned NumPy/SciPy for search. No GPU.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt coordinates the incubated project; scientific acceptance requires review. No fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. See PARTICIPATION.md.
